g.title: web
g.text: Show authorised results and collect actions.

g.title: endpoints
g.text: R1–R6 · Verify before routing every request.
Map typed results to HTTP responses.

g.title: identity_gateway
g.text: R1, R4 · Verify every protected request.

g.title: endpoints->identity_gateway
g.text: Run before Workshop Service / Reservation Rules

g.title: workshop
g.text: R2, R3, R5 · create / publish / browse / attendees
Generate unique ID; owner = verified student ID.
Only owner publishes or reads attendees.

g.title: reservation
g.text: Reject unverified; return repeat unchanged first.
Check published and capacity inside one lock.
Email only after committing a new seat.

g.title: repository
g.text: One connection, READ COMMITTED; lock workshop
before fresh reads, seat count and insert.
Every reservation writer uses this lock.

g.title: workshop->repository
g.text: save Workshop; publish if owner matches
read attendees only after owner check

g.title: mail_gateway
g.text: One attempt; never undo a saved seat.

g.title: db
g.text: CHECK capacity 1–20; nonempty title; NOT NULL fields.

g.title: repository->db
g.text: SELECT workshop FOR UPDATE; fresh seat reads

g.title: legend
g.text: Blue boxes = components inside one Board API process.
Internal arrows = Python calls; ← = returned data.
Grey = external systems; green = persistent store.
Attendee = {name,email}; only the workshop owner can request it.
Remaining = capacity − stored count (one consistent query snapshot).
R1–R6 refer to the customer rules on the student sheet.
